parent.f113_prior: 144/144 F112 previously trained six-feature and untrained fixed-feature each on source-ID full equality; 36/144 depth shortcut; zero learned-only wins; public engineering only
parent.parallel_f113_note: PR407 already explores fuzzy edit matching; F114 instead precommits IDENTIFIABILITY + selective abstention on missing/tied information.

question: When only one source value may be read, can public-information certificates separate uniquely resolvable retrieval, public-relationally resolvable ties, and provably unresolvable two-source ties without covert future-label use?

cohorts.name: W114-U
cohorts.design: Unique edit-distance-one nearest source among four; no exact string equality; other IDs distance>=5

cohorts.name: W114-R
cohorts.design: Two source IDs equally distance one from missing query ID, public role witness uniquely matches query role for target; other two IDs distance>=5

cohorts.name: W114-I
cohorts.design: 24 twins of identical public query/source ID/observation order/role metadata, each twin assigns positive/negative sign flip alternately to one of two equally near role-indistinguishable candidates; other two IDs distance>=5
cohorts.target_tag: for twin id floor(offset/2), target=base tag on even twin and rival=(base+2)%4 on odd twin

generator.nonce: Seeded from within-cohort local index, never exposed as model-visible seed; generated names do not repeat or overlap previous F113/F112 public examples.
generator.nearest_source: Query is a one-character substitution of a randomly chosen target source ID, exactly one distance-one candidate in U; exactly two distance-one candidates in R/I. Distinct source ID strings all unique.
generator.ambiguity_creation: Rival is query with one DIFFERENT character position substituted; no candidate equals query. Other two codes are independently seeded and require edit distance>=5 to query.
generator.public_query_role: In R, target role equals query role and rival role differs; in I both near candidate roles equal the query role. Role witness is public information, not a withheld answer or revealed target ID.
generator.query_depth: Balanced across tags and cohort positions; all 16 query-depth x tag cells occur at least twice in resolvable cohorts; depth never used by certificate.
generator.counterfactual: Positive and negative observation tuples differ by exactly ONE sign at hidden target; source code/roles/order/query identical; candidate must choose source BEFORE reading one sign. I twins share identical PUBLIC information but differ hidden target.
generator.no_weak_source_position_leak: Only public source strings, public role labels, query role, and observation order available to candidate policy; no seed, cohort tag, target tag, twin index, positive/negative sign, future source or true answer.
generator.cost_cap: Each predictor may choose one source then read that source's sign OR abstain; no reading multiple evidence values at inference, no hidden training/evaluation label.
generator.case_classes_known_to_evaluator_not_sele: The case class is not a predictor argument; diagnostics retain it only after decisions.

policies.certificate: Compute public Levenshtein distance from query string to each source. Reject if no minimum<=1. If unique minimum, select it; if multiple minimum<=1, retain only candidates whose public role equals query role; select if exactly one; otherwise ABSTAIN. Do not access any sign/answer before choice.
policies.forced_string: Same public minimum-distance, fixed lowest tag on tie; never abstain. Identical single evidence-value read.
policies.forced_relation: Same role-tie-breaking when unique, otherwise fixed lowest tag; never abstain. Identical public information and one evidence-value read.
policies.learned_F112: Previously trained F112 six-weight engineered-feature metric on its original 96 public TRAIN and 100 updates, no F114 fitting; no role input because parent interface does not have it; forced one-read.
policies.oracle: OFFLINE ONLY gold-index comparator/upper bound, prohibited for online policy.
policies.utility: Correct one-sign paired retrieval +1, wrong -4, abstain -0.1; report error risk, coverage, utility separately; 4:1 harm ratio is hypothetical and not inferred from public data.

frozen_thresholds.validity: Each block exactly 48 pairs; U has exactly 1 nearest and no exact match; R/I have exactly 2 nearest and no exact match; all R have unique valid role witness; all I have two indistinguishable matches; 24 I twin pairs have byte-identical public features and complementary gold targets; every block control complete and no target labels revealed.
frozen_thresholds.certificate: Coverage U >=44/48, R>=44/48, I exactly 0/48; zero false retrieval among certificate-covered cases; any violation => NEGATIVE. Do not call independent science acceptance.
frozen_thresholds.impossibility: For the 24 publicly identical I twins, any deterministic public-only one-read choice gets at most 24/48 paired correct, because target alternates. Test this for fixed forced policy and learned parent where metadata identical, but do not claim upper bound for sign-adaptive or multi-read policies (forbidden).
frozen_thresholds.risk_comparison: Record coverage, paired correct, wrong and explicit utility for certificate, forced string, forced relation, parent learned, always abstain. Success is safer selective inference, NOT evidence of learning or independent generalization.
frozen_thresholds.no_tuning: No changed cohort, seeds, roles, rankings or thresholds after any F114 result. Preserve every negative and refused case; source-prefix SHA256, all 144 case metrics and two independent OS reports.
